answer: A compromised software whisper cannot bypass cryptographic cold-chain attestation tokens that tether each agent identity to unique, physically bounded Trusted Platform Modules. To forge credentials, an adversary must procure costly hardware enclaves, exhausting capital just as heat exposure ruins spoiled vaccine vials in an unmonitored meadow. The limit of this physical root of trust is supply-chain capture, where a compromised fabrication batch acts like rotten timber passing inspection to inject malicious agent nodes.
